title: IDD Provider Outage Park Marker Payload
description: Structured payload parsed from an idd-provider-outage-park comment posted on a parked pull request. Never a merge-readiness or CI-gate result: parking never resolves a thread, satisfies a gate, or merges.

actor.description: Agent id of the session that parked this pull request, as embedded in the marker.

issueNumber.description: The originating issue whose claim was released on entry; a later resume re-claims this issue rather than re-parsing the pull request body's closing keyword.

service.description: The providerHealth service this pull request was parked for (e.g. advisory-review, ci-actions).

headSha.description: The pull request's HEAD commit SHA at the moment it was parked.

claimId.description: The active claim id on the originating issue at park time.

parkedAt.description: UTC timestamp the pull request was parked. The only timestamp safe to select or sort on -- never the comment's own createdAt, which degrades to "none" on an unreadable read.

createdAt.description: The GitHub-assigned created_at of the comment carrying this marker, or "none" when unavailable. Diagnostic only.
